7.0 GUIDELINES FOR FILLING IN THE SCHOOL YEAR REPORT
8.0 GENERAL INFORMATION
8.1 Year:
8.1.1 The calendar year for which the report is made.
8.2 Learner’s date of birth
8.2.1 The learner’s day, month and year of birth.
8.3 Gender:
8.3.1 Male or female.
8.4 Learner’s grade:
8.4.1 The learners grade for which the report is made.
8.5 UPI Number:
8.5.1 The Unique Personal Identifier (Nemis) number.
9.0 ATTENDANCE
9.1 Indicate the number of days the learner was absent in each term.
9.2 Indicate the total number of school days in that particular term.
10.0 LEARNER’S PERFORMANCE LEVEL
10.1 Exceeding Expectation:
10.1.1 The learner’s performance is well above the expected standard for the Grade at the time of reporting.
10.2 Meeting Expectation:
10.2.1 The learner’s performance is at the expected standard for the Grade at the time of reporting.
10.3 Approaching Expectation:
10.3.1 The learner’s performance is on track towards the expected standard with the suggested support.
10.4 Below Expectation:
10.4.1 The learner’s performance is below the expected standard and needs the suggested remedial support.
10.5 Teachers statement on the learner’s performance:
10.5.1 For each strand describe what was done well, improvement needed and how the improvement can be
 achieved.
11.0 LEARNER’S CONDUCT AND BEHAVIOUR
11.1 Classroom conduct:
11.1.1 General conduct of the learner with regard to learning experiences and their performance.
11.2 Work completion:
11.2.1 Remarks on the learner’s ability to complete tasks given considering excellence and self drive.
11.3 Working with others:
11.3.1 Remarks on the learner’s ability to interact well with others in and out of the class.
12.0 CORE COMPETENCIES AND VALUES
12.1 A description of core competencies and values acquired by the learner during the year,
 improvement needed and how the improvement can be achieved.
13.0 EVIDENCE OF PARTICIPATION IN COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING PROGRAM
13.1.1 Indicate any community service learning activity the learner has participated in during the year, what
 was done well, improvement needed and how the improvement can be achieved.
14.0 SIGNING
14.1 The School Year Report should be signed by the class teacher, head teacher and parent/guardian.
